stages.name: component
stages.source:
a0-0 = Attention(Q=['token', 'pos'], K=['token', 'pos'], V=['token', 'pos'])
m0 = MLP(inp=['token', 'pos', 'a0-0'])
output = Unembed(inp=['token', 'pos', 'a0-0', 'm0'])

stages.name: full_path
source:
prediction = softmax(logits1+
			logits2+
			logits3+
			logits4+
			logits5+
			logits6)
stages.renderer_adaptation: upstream full-path renderer has undefined heatmap labels; rendered equivalent expanded config with upstream QK renderer

stages.name: qk
source:
prediction = softmax(logits1+
			logits2+
			logits3+
			logits4+
			logits5+
			logits6)

provenance.driver: bounded AdamW MaskSampler and auxiliary update from patching.py; MLP primitives from convert_mlp.py; HTCondor not used
compatibility_adaptations: broadcast cached positional embeddings across QK batches
QK renderer fallback for full-path renderer undefined heatmap labels
full-path output ablation warm-started from the previous stage
QK affine query bias warm-started from the full-path query vector, then AdamW

fidelity.claim: measured answer-position fidelity of a capped local coefficient search; not a paper reproduction or logit equivalence

normalization.layernorm: per-vertex calibration log-variance, then AdamW on LN_var within the step cap
normalization.acceptance: every requested answer position, and the initial linear LayerNorm engine must already match
